title: CIRPASS Textile Ontology
description: Modular ontology network for textile product information in Digital Product Passports, covering product structure, processes, durability, assessment, indicators, context, repairability, recyclability, associated materials and substances of concern.

classes.label: Abrasion resistance
classes.comment: Observed performance parameter describing the resistance of a textile material or product to wear caused by rubbing or abrasion.

classes.label: Accidental damage
classes.comment: External damage occurring during use, such as accidental tearing, ripping or staining, which may lead to product rejection or disposal.

classes.label: Ageing simulation method
classes.comment: Test method that applies controlled and repeatable use or care cycles to simulate product ageing before or during durability assessment.

classes.label: Assembly characteristic
classes.comment: Characteristic of garment or textile assembly, including seams, sewing and cutting quality.

classes.label: Assembly performance parameter
classes.comment: Category of observed performance parameters related to seams, assembly or garment construction.

classes.label: Assessment condition
classes.comment: Condition under which an assessment execution is performed or a result is obtained.

classes.label: Assessment decision criterion
classes.comment: Criterion used to interpret, accept, reject, classify or otherwise decide on an assessment result.

classes.label: Assessment element
classes.comment: Generic superclass for entities used to specify, perform, interpret or report a textile assessment.

classes.label: Assessment execution
classes.comment: Concrete performance of an assessment method on a specified product under stated conditions and parameter settings.

classes.label: Assessment method
classes.comment: Procedure or documented approach used to assess, observe, test, measure or evaluate a textile product or a durability-related performance parameter.

classes.label: Assessment parameter
classes.comment: Parameter used to configure, qualify or interpret an assessment procedure.

classes.label: Assessment result
classes.comment: Output produced by an assessment execution, observation, test or evaluation.

classes.label: Assessment standard
classes.comment: Normative or reference document that defines, constrains or supports assessment methods, conditions, result interpretation or decision criteria.

classes.label: Care method concept
classes.comment: SKOS concept used as a controlled value for a textile care method.

classes.label: Care parameter
classes.comment: Process parameter relevant to textile care, including washing, drying, ironing, bleaching, cleaning or storage conditions.

classes.label: Cellulosic chemical recycling process
classes.comment: Chemical recycling process for cellulosic textile feedstock, producing cellulosic pulp or another recovered cellulosic feedstock.

classes.label: Chain-of-custody verification method
classes.comment: Third-party verification method relying on chain-of-custody tracking of recycled material.

classes.label: Chemical finishing process
classes.comment: Finishing process using chemical substances or treatments to confer or modify functional properties of textile materials or products.

classes.label: Chemical recycling process
classes.comment: Recycling process using chemical transformation to recover material from textile products or textile waste.

classes.label: Chemical recycling route
classes.comment: Recycling route whose principal recycling stage chemically transforms textile inputs to recover polymeric, cellulosic or other material feedstock.

classes.label: Cleaning process
classes.comment: Care process involving domestic laundering, professional cleaning, dry cleaning or wet cleaning of a textile product.

classes.label: Coating additive use
classes.comment: The additive substance or chemical role should be represented in TEXTILE_ASSOCIATED_MATERIALS. This parameter only records the process-use aspect.

classes.label: Coating parameter
classes.comment: Process parameter relevant to textile coating or surface treatment.

classes.label: Coating process
classes.comment: Finishing process applying a coating layer or functional surface treatment to a textile material or product.

classes.label: Collection for recycling process
classes.comment: End-of-life process in which discarded textile products are collected for potential sorting, preparation and recycling.

classes.label: Colour depth and evenness
classes.comment: Observed visual performance parameter describing the depth and evenness of colour in a textile product or fabric, especially in relation to dyeing and finishing quality.

classes.label: Colour fading
classes.comment: Visual failure mode corresponding to progressive loss of colour intensity during use, washing, ageing or exposure.

classes.label: Colour fastness
classes.comment: Observed performance parameter describing the resistance of a textile colour to fading, running or alteration under conditions such as washing, rubbing, perspiration or light exposure.

classes.label: Component failure mode
classes.comment: Category of failure modes affecting components or trims.

classes.label: Confectioning parameter
classes.comment: Process parameter relevant to garment making, cutting, sewing, assembly or make-up operations.

classes.label: Confectioning process
classes.comment: Manufacturing process transforming fabrics and components into finished textile apparel or textile articles, including cutting, sewing and make-up operations.

classes.label: Cut precision
classes.comment: Assembly characteristic concerning precision of cutting or pattern construction.

classes.label: Cutting parameter
classes.comment: Confectioning parameter relevant to cutting operations.

classes.label: Cutting process
classes.comment: Confectioning process in which textile materials are cut into components or pattern pieces.

classes.label: Defect control
classes.comment: Process parameter or quality-control practice aimed at preventing or detecting defects during textile processing.

classes.label: Deformation performance parameter
classes.comment: Category of observed performance parameters related to deformation, shape retention or dimensional behaviour.

classes.label: Degradation rate
classes.comment: Calculated indicator expressing change in a performance parameter or degradation phenomenon per stated unit of time, use, cycle or exposure.

classes.label: Digital repair guidance
classes.comment: Repair guidance provided in digital form and capable of carrying a web link through the DPP digital-instruction pattern.

classes.label: Digital textile care instruction
classes.comment: Textile care instruction supplied in a digital form, for example through a Digital Product Passport or a linked digital resource.

classes.label: Digital textile end-of-life instruction
classes.comment: Textile end-of-life instruction supplied in digital form, for example through a Digital Product Passport or a linked digital resource.

classes.label: Dimensional stability
classes.comment: Observed performance parameter describing the ability of a textile product or fabric to retain its dimensions after use, laundering or other treatment cycles.

classes.label: Disassembly feature
classes.comment: Design feature describing whether a product or relevant element can be taken apart for repair, upgrade, refurbishment or remanufacturing.

classes.label: Discolouration
classes.comment: Kept distinct from colour fading because discolouration may be localised, irregular or caused by specific use or exposure conditions.

classes.label: Drying process
classes.comment: Care process involving drying of a textile product, including tumble drying or line drying.

classes.label: Drying temperature
classes.comment: Care parameter describing drying temperature used during care.

classes.label: Durability
classes.comment: Ability of a product to maintain over time its function and performance under specified conditions of use, maintenance and repair.

classes.label: Durability assessment
classes.comment: Assessment execution focused on durability-related characteristics, degradation phenomena, failure modes or derived durability indicators of a textile product.

classes.label: Durability indicator
classes.comment: Indicator used to express or interpret durability-related evidence about a textile product.

classes.label: Dye concentration
classes.comment: Dyeing parameter describing the concentration of dye or colourant used in a dyeing process.

classes.label: Dyeing parameter
classes.comment: Process parameter relevant to textile dyeing.

classes.label: Dyeing process
classes.comment: Wet processing process used to impart colour to textile fibres, yarns, fabrics or finished products.

classes.label: Dyeing temperature
classes.comment: Dyeing parameter describing the temperature used during a dyeing process.

classes.label: Dyeing time
classes.comment: Dyeing parameter describing the duration of a dyeing process or dyeing step.

classes.label: Ease of disassembly
classes.comment: Disassembly feature concerning the ease with which a product or relevant element can be taken apart without damage or excessive effort.

classes.label: Elasticity loss
classes.comment: Structural failure mode corresponding to loss of elasticity, elastic recovery or stretch-related functionality of a textile product or fabric.

classes.label: Electronic textile
classes.comment: Textile-based system that exhibits an intended and exploitable response to changes in its surroundings or to an external signal or input.

classes.label: End-of-life process
classes.comment: Process occurring at or after the end of the use phase of a textile product, including reuse, recycling, incineration or landfilling.

classes.label: Estimated lifetime
classes.comment: An estimated lifetime is not a directly measured property and must identify its evidence, method and assumptions.

classes.label: External damage
classes.comment: Damage caused by external or accidental events during product use, not necessarily resulting from intrinsic lack of durability.

classes.label: Fabric
classes.comment: Textile product made from yarns, fibres or filaments and intended to be incorporated into another textile product or used in further manufacturing.

classes.label: Fabric appearance
classes.comment: Fabric visual characteristic concerning the overall visible appearance or visual quality of a fabric.

classes.label: Fabric behavioural characteristic
classes.comment: Fabric-level characteristic concerning the physical behaviour of a fabric under use, gravity, movement, care or stress conditions.

classes.label: Fabric breakdown
classes.comment: Aggregated failure mode. It may be decomposed later into more specific phenomena such as fraying, thinning, localised wear or hole formation.

classes.label: Fabric breathability
classes.comment: Fabric functional characteristic concerning the passage of water vapour through the fabric and evaporative cooling.

classes.label: Fabric characteristic
classes.comment: Fabric-level characteristic relevant to durability, comfort, appearance or functional performance.

classes.label: Fabric construction characteristic
classes.comment: Fabric structural characteristic concerning fabric construction, density, mass per area or arrangement of yarns/threads.

classes.label: Fabric construction parameter
classes.comment: Process-side parameter describing how a fabric construction is specified or controlled during manufacturing. The resulting observable construction characteristics are represented in TEXTILE_STRUCTURE.

classes.label: Fabric drape
classes.comment: Fabric behavioural characteristic concerning how a fabric hangs in three dimensions and adapts to contours.

classes.label: Fabric elasticity
classes.comment: Fabric structural characteristic denoting elastic behaviour of the fabric.

classes.label: Fabric functional characteristic
classes.comment: Fabric-level characteristic concerning functional performance relevant to use, comfort or intended application.

classes.label: Fabric handle
classes.comment: Fabric tactile characteristic concerning softness, smoothness, flexibility and overall sensation when touched.

classes.label: Fabric insulation
classes.comment: Fabric functional characteristic concerning the retention of heat and reduction of heat transfer.

classes.label: Fabric lustre
classes.comment: Fabric visual characteristic concerning the reflection of light that creates a shiny or glossy appearance.

classes.label: Fabric manufacturing parameter
classes.comment: This superclass covers process-side parameters used during fabric manufacturing. It should not be used to represent the resulting structural characteristics of the fabric as a product object.

classes.label: Fabric manufacturing process
classes.comment: Manufacturing process transforming yarns, fibres or filaments into fabric structures.

classes.label: Fabric mass per unit area
classes.comment: Fabric construction characteristic expressing the mass of fabric per unit surface area.

classes.label: Fabric rigidity
classes.comment: Fabric structural characteristic denoting rigidity or stiffness.

classes.label: Fabric smoothness
classes.comment: Observed performance parameter describing the visible or tactile smoothness of a fabric surface, commonly considered during visual inspection after washing, drying or other durability-related stress.

classes.label: Fabric strength
classes.comment: Aggregated observed mechanical performance parameter describing the strength of a fabric, potentially covering tensile strength, tear strength or bursting strength depending on the test context.

classes.label: Fabric structural characteristic
classes.comment: Characteristic of fabric structure or fabric-level physical behaviour.

classes.label: Fabric tactile characteristic
classes.comment: Fabric-level characteristic concerning touch, hand-feel or perceived tactile behaviour.

classes.label: Fabric visual characteristic
classes.comment: Fabric-level characteristic concerning visible appearance, lustre, shininess, sheen or other visual qualities.

classes.label: Failure mode
classes.comment: Failure modes are kept separate from observed performance parameters. For example, colour fastness is a parameter, while colour fading is a failure mode.

classes.label: Fibre characteristic
classes.comment: A characteristic of a textile fibre that can influence yarn manufacture, fabric behaviour and durability-related performance.

classes.label: Fibre cleanliness
classes.comment: Fibre quality characteristic concerning impurities or foreign matter remaining in the fibre.

classes.label: Fibre colour
classes.comment: Visual fibre characteristic concerning the colour of a fibre and its influence on dyeing or bleaching behaviour.

classes.label: Fibre composition component
classes.comment: A structured component of a textile product fibre composition, specifying a fibre type and its quantitative share in the product.

classes.label: Fibre elasticity
classes.comment: Mechanical fibre characteristic concerning deformation and recovery after removal of a load.

classes.label: Fibre fineness
classes.comment: Structural fibre characteristic expressing fibre fineness or linear density.

classes.label: Fibre length
classes.comment: Structural fibre characteristic expressing the length of textile fibres.

classes.label: Fibre preparation process
classes.comment: Manufacturing process preparing fibres for yarn manufacturing or textile production.

classes.label: Fibre quality characteristic
classes.comment: Fibre characteristic concerning fibre quality conditions that are not purely structural, mechanical, physical or visual.

classes.label: Fibre section shape
classes.comment: Structural fibre characteristic expressing the cross-sectional shape of textile fibres.

classes.label: Fibre strength
classes.comment: Mechanical fibre characteristic expressing resistance of fibres to tensile stress or breakage.

classes.label: Finishing parameter
classes.comment: Process parameter relevant to textile finishing, including chemical and mechanical finishing.

classes.label: Finishing process
classes.comment: Textile process applied to modify appearance, handle, function or physical properties of textile materials or products.

classes.label: Finishing treatment parameter
classes.comment: Process parameter describing a finishing treatment type, intensity, duration or configuration.

classes.label: Fixation condition
classes.comment: Dyeing or printing parameter describing conditions used to fix a dye, pigment, print or finish to the textile material.

classes.label: Functional failure mode
classes.comment: Category of failure modes primarily involving loss of intended use, comfort or functional suitability of a textile product.

classes.label: Fuzzing or matting
classes.comment: Observed surface degradation phenomenon involving fuzzing or matting of the fabric surface. The term follows the JRC and ISO wording 'fuzzing or matting', not 'melting'.

classes.label: Hole in seam
classes.comment: Specific seam failure involving a hole or localised opening at or around a seam.

classes.label: Humidity control
classes.comment: Process parameter describing control of humidity during textile manufacturing, processing or care.

classes.label: Incineration process
classes.comment: End-of-life process involving combustion of textile products or textile waste.

classes.label: Indicator
classes.comment: Derived information object used to calculate, interpret, aggregate, compare or communicate evidence about a textile product. An indicator is not the underlying assessment result, characteristic, threshold or quantitative value.

classes.label: Input yarn count specification
classes.comment: A process target or input specification stating the yarn count or yarn linear-density class selected for fabric manufacturing.

classes.label: Interactive repair support
classes.comment: Interactive real-time digital repair guidance, for example through augmented reality, artificial intelligence or another interactive technology.

classes.label: Intermediate textile characteristic
classes.comment: Characteristic of an intermediate textile structure such as yarn, fabric, resistance property or assembly.

classes.label: Interpretation scale
classes.comment: Scale used to interpret, classify or rate an assessment result.

classes.label: Intrinsic durability
classes.comment: Durability construct based on the physical and measurable ability of a textile product to maintain relevant performance characteristics over time under specified use, maintenance or test conditions.

classes.label: Ironing process
classes.comment: Confectioning or care-related process applying heat and pressure to shape, smooth or finish textile products.

classes.label: Ironing temperature
classes.comment: Care parameter describing ironing temperature.

classes.label: Knitting pattern specification
classes.comment: A process target specification stating the knitting structure or pattern to be produced.

classes.label: Knitting process
classes.comment: Fabric manufacturing process in which yarns are interlooped using needles to form fabric on knitting machines.

classes.label: Laminating process
classes.comment: Finishing or assembly process joining textile materials with layers or membranes.

classes.label: Landfilling process
classes.comment: End-of-life process involving disposal of textile products or textile waste in landfill.

classes.label: Life-extension intervention aspect
classes.comment: Product aspect concerning intervention-based extension or restoration of textile-product use, functionality or value through repair, upgrade, refurbishment or remanufacturing. It is an organising class and not a score.

classes.label: Life-extension product event
classes.comment: A concrete textile process occurrence that is also interpreted as a product lifecycle event intended to extend, restore or substantially change the useful life, functionality or condition of a textile product.

classes.label: Lifetime indicator
classes.comment: Durability indicator expressing, estimating or interpreting a product lifespan or duration of service.

classes.label: Lifetime of product
classes.comment: Indicator expressing a stated, observed or inferred lifespan of a textile product using a specified lifespan descriptor and stated assumptions.

classes.label: Liquor ratio
classes.comment: Dyeing-process parameter expressing the relation between the quantity of treatment liquor and the mass of dry textile material. The reporting basis and unit must be stated explicitly.

classes.label: Logo failure
classes.comment: Logo failure may also be interpreted as a component-related failure depending on whether the logo is printed, embroidered or applied as a separate component. It is kept under visual failure mode in this module.

classes.label: Loss of comfort
classes.comment: Functional failure mode corresponding to loss of comfort or comfort-related suitability during use, maintenance or ageing.

classes.label: Loss of dimensional stability
classes.comment: Failure expression corresponding to loss of the ability of a textile product or fabric to retain its dimensions after use, laundering or treatment cycles.

classes.label: Machinery characteristic
classes.comment: Process parameter or equipment characteristic describing machinery quality, configuration or components relevant to textile processing.

classes.label: Maintenance and repair process
classes.comment: This class groups processes that are related to lifetime extension but are not assessment indicators. Product lifetime itself is represented in TEXTILE_INDICATOR.

classes.label: Manufacturer-declaration verification method
classes.comment: Verification method based on a declaration made by the manufacturer.

classes.label: Measurement parameter
classes.comment: Protocol parameter that is controlled or recorded during a measurement or test, distinct from the product performance characteristic being assessed.

classes.label: Measurement parameter setting
classes.comment: Concrete assignment of a quantitative or controlled value to a measurement parameter in an assessment execution or protocol.

classes.label: Measurement result
classes.comment: Assessment result that records a quantitative value, qualitative outcome or controlled rating obtained from a measurement or test.

classes.label: Mechanical failure mode
classes.comment: Category of failure modes primarily involving rupture, tearing or mechanical damage.

classes.label: Mechanical fibre characteristic
classes.comment: Fibre characteristic concerning mechanical behaviour such as strength or elasticity.

classes.label: Mechanical finishing process
classes.comment: Finishing process using mechanical treatment to modify physical properties, surface behaviour, handle or appearance of textile materials or products.

classes.label: Mechanical performance parameter
classes.comment: Category of observed performance parameters related to mechanical resistance or strength.

classes.label: Mechanical recycling process
classes.comment: Recycling process mechanically transforming textile products or textile waste into reusable fibres or materials.

classes.label: Mechanical recycling route
classes.comment: Recycling route whose principal recycling stage mechanically transforms textile inputs into reusable fibres or materials.

classes.label: Medical device textile apparel
classes.comment: Textile apparel identified as a medical device or as an accessory for a medical device in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2017/745.

classes.label: Modularity feature
classes.comment: Design feature by which relevant product elements are modular, detachable or interchangeable in support of repair or upgrade.

classes.label: Moisture retention
classes.comment: Physical fibre characteristic concerning the capacity of fibres to absorb or retain moisture.

classes.label: Non-textile component
classes.comment: A physical component integrated into a textile product that is not itself part of the primary textile fibre composition, such as a button, zipper or sequin.

classes.label: Non-textile component material group
classes.comment: A material grouping associated with one or more non-textile components, used as a location or concentration reference unit without treating the component itself as a material group.

classes.label: Nonwoven manufacturing process
classes.comment: Fabric manufacturing process producing nonwoven textile structures by bonding or entangling fibres or filaments.

classes.label: Number of cycles
classes.comment: Measurement parameter specifying the number of repeated test, washing, abrasion or simulated-use cycles.

classes.label: Number of use cycles
classes.comment: This indicator concerns product use and must not be confused with txtass:NumberOfCycles used as a test-protocol parameter.

classes.label: Observed degradation phenomenon
classes.comment: Observable phenomenon indicating physical deterioration of a textile material or product. It is distinct from the performance characteristic used to assess resistance to that deterioration.

classes.label: Observed performance parameter
classes.comment: Durability-related product characteristic that can be observed, assessed or measured to evaluate physical durability. It denotes the characteristic type, not a test, observation, result or quantitative value.

classes.label: Packaging material
classes.comment: A material occurrence used for the packaging, transport, storage or delivery of a textile product.

classes.label: Packaging process
classes.comment: PackagingProcess is included so that packaging material can be used as an input in a process context without treating packaging material as an input to ordinary textile manufacturing processes.

classes.label: Performance after N cycles
classes.comment: Derived performance indicator reporting a performance state or level after a stated number and type of use, wash, abrasion, ageing or other cycles.

classes.label: Performance indicator
classes.comment: Durability indicator expressing a derived level, score, rate, retention or trajectory of a durability-related performance parameter.

classes.label: Performance level over time
classes.comment: A performance trajectory should preserve the underlying assessment results or constituent point indicators from which it was derived.

classes.label: Performance retention rate
classes.comment: Calculated indicator expressing retained performance relative to an initial or reference performance value under stated calculation rules.

classes.label: Performance threshold
classes.comment: Decision criterion specifying a minimum, maximum, target or equality value against which a result is evaluated.

classes.label: Physical fibre characteristic
classes.comment: Fibre characteristic concerning physical behaviour such as moisture retention.

classes.label: Pilling
classes.comment: Observed surface degradation phenomenon involving the formation of small balls or pills of entangled fibres on a textile surface during wear, friction, use or testing.

classes.label: Pilling resistance
classes.comment: Durability-related performance characteristic describing the ability of a textile material, fabric or product to resist the formation of pills under friction, wear or use conditions.

classes.label: Polycotton thermo-chemical recycling process
classes.comment: Chemical or thermo-chemical recycling process for polycotton blends, producing cellulosic pulp, polyester fibres, polymers or monomers depending on the applied technique.

classes.label: PPE textile apparel
classes.comment: Textile apparel identified as personal protective equipment in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/425.

classes.label: Preparation for recycling process
classes.comment: End-of-life process that prepares a textile product or material for recycling, including removal, cleaning, cutting, opening or other pre-treatment required by a route.

classes.label: Printing binder use
classes.comment: The binder substance or chemical role should be represented in TEXTILE_ASSOCIATED_MATERIALS. This parameter only records the process-use aspect.

classes.label: Printing parameter
classes.comment: Process parameter relevant to textile printing.

classes.label: Printing process
classes.comment: Textile process applying colour, patterns or markings to textile materials or products.

classes.label: Priority repair element
classes.comment: Assessment role assigned to a product element that is important for repairability because of failure frequency or functional relevance. The physical element itself remains represented in the appropriate textile or component module.

classes.label: Process control parameter
classes.comment: A process parameter that controls, configures or monitors the execution conditions of a textile process.

classes.label: Process method concept
classes.comment: SKOS concept used as a controlled value for a textile process method or technique.

classes.label: Process parameter
classes.comment: A semantic type for a configurable process condition, method choice, control variable or target specification relevant to a textile process.

classes.label: Process parameter setting
classes.comment: A concrete value or selected category assigned to a process parameter for a specific process execution.

classes.label: Process target specification
classes.comment: A process-side specification stating a target product or intermediate-product characteristic to be achieved by a process.

classes.label: Product ageing
classes.comment: Progressive change or degradation of textile product performance over time under repeated use, care, environmental exposure or stress.

classes.label: Product replacement frequency
classes.comment: Replacement frequency is not a direct measure of intrinsic durability because disposal and replacement also depend on fit, perceived value, fashion and other contextual factors.

classes.label: Pyrolysis or gasification recycling process
classes.comment: Thermo-chemical process producing syngas or pyrolysis oil that may be used as feedstock for material production. Use of the output as fuel is energy recovery and is not represented as recycling.

classes.label: Quantitative value
classes.comment: A numerical value expressed using a measurement unit and, when useful, a kind of quantity.

classes.label: Radiation-induced degradation
classes.comment: Degradation of textile material or product properties associated with ultraviolet or other relevant radiation exposure.

classes.label: Rating scale
classes.comment: Interpretation scale composed of controlled rating values or grades.

classes.label: Rating value concept
classes.comment: SKOS concept used as a controlled rating value, grade or scale level.

classes.label: Recovered material quality result
classes.comment: Assessment result describing whether recovered textile material meets stated quality requirements for a target use.

classes.label: Recovered textile material
classes.comment: Material output recovered from an actual textile recycling process and potentially usable as input to another production process.

classes.label: Recyclability
classes.comment: Potential of a textile product, under a specified collection, sorting, preparation and recycling context, to provide fibre or material feedstock usable in one or more recycling routes without disruptive elements or substances.

classes.label: Recyclability assessment
classes.comment: Concrete execution of a recyclability assessment method on a specified textile product for stated recycling routes and conditions.

classes.label: Recyclability assessment method
classes.comment: Reusable procedure for evaluating textile-product recyclability against stated criteria, assumed system conditions and one or more recycling routes.

classes.label: Recyclability assessment result
classes.comment: Result produced by a recyclability assessment, reporting route-specific criterion outcomes, barriers, recyclable fraction, score or label when applicable.

classes.label: Recyclability barrier
classes.comment: Product, material, substance, information or system condition that hinders collection, sorting, preparation, recycling or the use and quality of recovered material for a specified route.

classes.label: Recyclability criterion result
classes.comment: Assessment result reporting the outcome of one controlled recyclability criterion for a product and, where relevant, a specified recycling route.

classes.label: Recyclability score
classes.comment: Method-specific indicator calculated from stated recyclability criteria and assumptions. A score does not by itself prove that a product will be collected or recycled in practice.

classes.label: Recyclability scoring method
classes.comment: Assessment method that combines criterion outcomes into a method-specific recyclability score or label. It is not a universal regulatory scoring formula.

classes.label: Recyclability scoring rule
classes.comment: Rule belonging to a recyclability scoring method and assigning a quantitative point value to a stated criterion under stated route or threshold conditions.

classes.label: Recycled content
classes.comment: Product aspect describing the proportion by mass of recycled fibres from post-industrial, pre-consumer or post-consumer waste in a textile product.

classes.label: Recycled content assessment
classes.comment: Assessment execution that verifies or evaluates a recycled-content declaration for a textile product.

classes.label: Recycled content assessment result
classes.comment: Assessment result reporting the outcome of verifying or evaluating a recycled-content declaration.

classes.label: Recycled content declaration
classes.comment: Declaration reporting the mass fraction of recycled material in a textile product or material. Recycled content is related to, but distinct from, recyclability.

classes.label: Recycled content performance threshold
classes.comment: Performance threshold defining a minimum recycled-content value for a stated product, fibre or source context. Candidate values proposed in the JRC design option remain assessment data rather than universal OWL axioms.

classes.label: Recycled content verification method
classes.comment: Assessment method used to verify a recycled-content declaration where no direct laboratory determination of recycled versus virgin fibre origin is available at scale.

classes.label: Recycled textile fibre
classes.comment: Recovered textile material represented as a textile fibre suitable, subject to quality and process requirements, for use in textile products.

classes.label: Recycling process
classes.comment: End-of-life process that transforms textile products, textile waste or recovered textile materials into reusable fibre or material feedstock.

classes.label: Recycling route
classes.comment: Specified sequence or configuration of collection, sorting, preparation and recycling stages used as the context for a recyclability assessment or actual recycling operation.

classes.label: Recycling yield result
classes.comment: Assessment result reporting the mass fraction or other stated yield of recovered material produced by an actual or modelled recycling operation.

classes.label: Reference period
classes.comment: Structured temporal interval used to qualify the period to which an observation, indicator or other time-bound textile statement applies.

classes.label: Possibility of refurbishment
classes.comment: Ability of a product or discarded product to be prepared, cleaned, tested, serviced and, where necessary, repaired so that performance or functionality is restored within the originally intended use and performance range.

classes.label: Refurbishment process
classes.comment: Process involving preparation, cleaning, testing, servicing and, where necessary, repair to restore a textile product within its originally intended use and performance range.

classes.label: Possibility of remanufacturing
classes.comment: Possibility of producing a new product from waste objects, products or components through actions involving at least one change that may affect the product performance, purpose or type.

classes.label: Remanufacturing process
classes.comment: Process producing a new textile product from waste objects, products or components, with at least one change that may affect performance, purpose or type. It is distinct from material recycling.

classes.label: Repairability
classes.comment: Ability of a defective product or waste object to return, through one or more actions, to a condition in which it fulfils its intended use. For textile apparel, user acceptance of restored functionality and potentially changed aesthetics is contextually relevant.

classes.label: Repairability assessment
classes.comment: Assessment execution that gathers contextual evidence about repairability-related product aspects, services, guidance, design features, priority elements, costs, spare-part availability and user acceptance. It does not itself constitute the result.

classes.label: Repairability assessment result
classes.comment: Result produced by a repairability assessment. It records the evidence-based outcome and relevant service configuration without asserting a universal objective repairability score.

classes.label: Repairability contextual condition
classes.comment: Assessment condition external to intrinsic product design that influences repair feasibility or the decision to repair.

classes.label: Repairability design feature
classes.comment: Design-related feature that may enable repair, upgrade, refurbishment or remanufacturing, such as modularity, standardisation or disassembly.

classes.label: Repair cost condition
classes.comment: Economic condition describing repair cost in relation to a comparable new product price and its influence on a repair decision.

classes.label: Repair guidance
classes.comment: Information or instructions supporting repair of textile apparel or common damaged elements. Guidance may be physical or digital and is distinct from the repair service and the repair operation.

classes.label: Repair process
classes.comment: Repair can extend the usable lifetime of a textile product, but this module does not import TEXTILE_INDICATOR. Links from repair to product lifetime indicators should be handled in TEXTILE_INDICATOR or in a cross-module relation layer.

classes.label: Repair-related life-extension process
classes.comment: Textile process type related to upgrade, refurbishment or remanufacturing and organised with repair under the broader family of life-extension interventions. Concrete operations are represented as txtprc:TextileProcessExecution.

classes.label: Repair service
classes.comment: Service that performs, organises or supports textile repair interventions, including company-provided, independent professional and community-supported repair.

classes.label: Resistance characteristic
classes.comment: Structural or material resistance characteristic, distinct from the observed degradation phenomenon itself.

classes.label: Reusable textile absorbent hygiene product
classes.comment: Reusable textile absorbent hygiene product considered a technical textile and excluded from scope.

classes.label: Reuse process
classes.comment: End-of-life or post-use process enabling a textile product to be used again without major material transformation.

classes.label: Robustness assessment
classes.comment: Assessment framework that evaluates resistance to selected external stresses and inspection parameters as a proxy for physical durability.

classes.label: Robustness score
classes.comment: Score produced by a robustness scoring method from selected textile test and visual-inspection results; it is proxy information for physical durability and is not a service-lifetime value.

classes.label: Robustness scoring method
classes.comment: Robustness assessment method that maps test and inspection results to points and combines them into a robustness score.

classes.label: Rough or stiff fabric
classes.comment: Failure mode in which a fabric becomes or is perceived as rough, stiff or unpleasant to touch, affecting user acceptance and comfort-related use.

classes.label: Seam construction parameter
classes.comment: Sewing parameter describing seam type, stitch, thread, construction or other seam-related configuration.

classes.label: Seam failure
classes.comment: Structural or assembly-related failure mode involving loss of seam integrity or seam functionality.

classes.label: Seam slippage
classes.comment: Durability-related assembly performance characteristic describing displacement of yarns at or near a seam under mechanical stress, which may lead to deformation or opening.

classes.label: Seam strength
classes.comment: Assembly characteristic expressing the mechanical strength or integrity of a seam.

classes.label: Sewing characteristic
classes.comment: Assembly characteristic concerning sewing quality or sewing-related construction.

classes.label: Sewing parameter
classes.comment: Confectioning parameter relevant to sewing operations and seam formation.

classes.label: Sewing process
classes.comment: Confectioning process joining textile parts or components using stitches or seams.

classes.label: Smart textile
classes.comment: Textile able to sense and react to environmental conditions or external stimuli through incorporated sensors or responsive components.

classes.label: Sorting for recycling process
classes.comment: End-of-life process in which collected textile products or materials are segregated into streams suitable for subsequent recycling routes.

classes.label: Spare-part availability condition
classes.comment: Condition describing whether a suitable spare component or replacement element is available for a contemplated repair. Availability may depend on collections, styles, colours, logistics and actual expected use.

classes.label: Spinning limit
classes.comment: Process parameter expressing the range of yarn counts achievable from a given fibre using a specific spinning system; it depends on the number and thickness of fibres or filaments twisted together.

classes.label: Spinning method parameter
classes.comment: When the selected method is represented directly as a controlled value on a spinning process, use txtprc:hasSpinningMethod with a txtprc:SpinningMethodConcept. This class is retained only when the method must be treated explicitly as a process parameter.

classes.label: Spinning parameter
classes.comment: Process parameter relevant to spinning or yarn manufacturing.

classes.label: Spinning process
classes.comment: Specific spinning techniques such as ring spinning, rotor open-end spinning and air-jet spinning are represented as SKOS concepts in the spinning method scheme.

classes.label: Spinning productivity
classes.comment: Process parameter expressing the finest yarn count producible from a given fibre while maintaining acceptable performance and minimising end-breakage rates.

classes.label: Spinning speed
classes.comment: Spinning parameter describing the speed of spinning.

classes.label: Spinning tension
classes.comment: Spinning parameter describing tension during spinning.

classes.label: Spin speed
classes.comment: Care parameter describing spin speed used in laundering.

classes.label: Standardisation feature
classes.comment: Design feature by which components or interfaces are standardised in a way that may support replacement, repair or upgrade.

classes.label: Storage condition parameter
classes.comment: Care parameter describing storage-related conditions, such as humidity, sunlight exposure, folding or hanging.

classes.label: Storage process
classes.comment: Use-phase or care-related process involving storage of a textile product under specified or unspecified conditions.

classes.label: Structural failure mode
classes.comment: Category of failure modes primarily affecting structure, integrity or dimensional behaviour.

classes.label: Structural fibre characteristic
classes.comment: Fibre characteristic concerning fibre structure, morphology or geometry.

classes.label: Surface degradation phenomenon
classes.comment: Observed degradation phenomenon affecting the surface condition of a textile material or product, such as pilling, fuzzing or matting.

classes.label: Surface failure mode
classes.comment: Category of failure modes primarily affecting the textile surface. Borderline surface phenomena that are also assessed as performance parameters should remain under ObservedDegradationPhenomenon to preserve the module disjointness pattern.

classes.label: Surface performance parameter
classes.comment: Category of observed performance parameters related to surface behaviour or surface degradation.

classes.label: Synthetic-fibre chemical recycling process
classes.comment: Chemical recycling process for synthetic textile feedstock such as polyester or polyamide 6, producing recovered monomers, oligomers or polymers.

classes.label: Tactile failure mode
classes.comment: Category of failure modes primarily affecting tactile perception, hand feel or comfort-related touch properties of a textile product or fabric.

classes.label: Target fabric density
classes.comment: A process target specification stating the intended thread or loop density of the resulting fabric.

classes.label: Target fabric mass per unit area
classes.comment: A process target specification stating the intended mass of fabric per unit surface area.

classes.label: Tear or rip
classes.comment: Mechanical failure mode involving rupture, tearing or ripping of textile material under stress, snagging or damage.

classes.label: Temperature control
classes.comment: Process parameter describing control of temperature during textile manufacturing, processing or care.

classes.label: Test condition
classes.comment: Controlled assessment condition used in a test protocol, such as temperature, humidity, load, duration, washing cycle or abrasion cycle.

classes.label: Test endpoint
classes.comment: Defined observation or stopping condition used to determine when a test is complete, such as specimen breakdown or a specified appearance change.

classes.label: Test execution
classes.comment: Assessment execution that performs a test method under controlled test conditions.

classes.label: Testing standard
classes.comment: Assessment standard specialised for test and verification procedures.

classes.label: Test method
classes.comment: Assessment method that applies a controlled experimental or inspection procedure to a durability-related performance parameter.

classes.label: Textile apparel
classes.comment: Textile products that aim to cover the body with everything except footwear, including clothing and clothing accessories worn to clothe, adorn, shield, provide comfort, or express identity and belonging.

classes.label: Textile care instruction
classes.comment: Product instruction describing recommended textile care operations or conditions, such as washing temperature and cycle, detergent use, drying, ironing, bleaching or professional cleaning.

classes.label: Textile chemical recycling event
classes.comment: Textile recycling event executing the chemical recycling process type.

classes.label: Textile chemical substance
classes.comment: A substance used or occurring in a textile manufacturing, treatment, finishing, coating or related textile-production context.

classes.label: Textile cleaning product
classes.comment: Textile cleaning product considered a technical textile and excluded from scope because its function differs from apparel.

classes.label: Textile concentration information
classes.comment: Concentration information for a substance present in a textile product, expressed at product, component, material-group or spare-part level as an exact value, maximum value or range.

classes.label: Textile context observation
classes.comment: A concrete observation, declaration or setting of a contextual condition applying to a textile product or a textile process execution.

classes.label: Textile end-of-life instruction
classes.comment: Product instruction supporting appropriate end-of-life handling of a textile product, including collection, sorting, preparation for reuse, material separation, recycling or another stated waste-management route.

classes.label: Textile fibre
classes.comment: Unit of matter characterised by flexibility, fineness and a high ratio of length to maximum transverse dimension, suitable for textile applications.

classes.label: Textile fibre-composition material group
classes.comment: Bridge class for a fibre-composition component that is used as the material-group scope of a textile substance-of-concern presence context.

classes.label: Textile manufacturing process
classes.comment: Textile process involved in the manufacturing or transformation of textile fibres, yarns, fabrics, assemblies or finished textile products.

classes.label: Textile material group
classes.comment: A fibre-, yarn- or fabric-based material grouping within a textile product that serves as a location or mass-reference unit for substance reporting.

classes.label: Textile mechanical recycling event
classes.comment: Textile recycling event executing the mechanical recycling process type.

classes.label: Textile process
classes.comment: A type of process involved in manufacturing, transforming, using, caring for, repairing, reusing, recycling or treating a textile product, including a product used as a component of another product.

classes.label: Textile process execution
classes.comment: A concrete occurrence of a textile process applied to one or more products, including products serving an intermediate or component role, materials or components.

classes.label: Textile product
classes.comment: Any raw, semi-worked, worked, semi-manufactured, manufactured, semi-made-up or made-up product which is exclusively composed of textile fibres, as well as a product containing at least 80% textile fibres by weight.

classes.label: Textile product-group SoC reference
classes.comment: A versioned reference identifying the textile-product-group source that qualifies a substance under the product-group-specific type (d) criterion.

classes.label: Textile recycling alert threshold
classes.comment: A textile-sector alert concentration used to inform sorting, recycling or environmentally sound end-of-life handling when the substance may hinder circular treatment.

classes.label: Textile recycling event
classes.comment: Concrete textile recycling occurrence represented both as a product event and as a textile process execution.

classes.label: Textile refurbishment event
classes.comment: A concrete textile refurbishment occurrence that is both a textile process execution and an instance of the EU DPP RefurbishmentEvent semantics.

classes.label: Textile remanufacturing event
classes.comment: A concrete textile remanufacturing occurrence that is both a textile process execution and an instance of the EU DPP RemanufacturingEvent semantics.

classes.label: Textile repair event
classes.comment: A concrete textile repair occurrence that is both a textile process execution and an instance of the EU DPP RepairEvent semantics.

classes.label: Textile SoC handling information
classes.comment: Textile-specific instruction information concerning safe use and lifecycle handling in the presence of a substance of concern, including disassembly, preparation for reuse, reuse, recycling and environmentally sound end-of-life management; repair guidance may be added as a textile/JRC extension.

classes.label: Textile structure characteristic
classes.comment: A property describing the structure, physical constitution, mechanical behaviour, tactile quality, visual quality or functional behaviour of a textile fibre, yarn, fabric or assembly.

classes.label: Textile substance of concern presence context
classes.comment: A substance-of-concern presence context specialised for a textile product, textile material group or non-textile component.

classes.label: Textile tracking threshold
classes.comment: A tracking or disclosure threshold applicable to a substance occurrence in a textile product or textile product group.

classes.label: Textile type (d) qualification
classes.comment: A product-group-specific type (d) qualification indicating that a substance hinders the reuse or recycling of a textile product or textile material stream.

classes.label: Textile upgrading event
classes.comment: A concrete textile upgrading occurrence that is both a textile process execution and an instance of the EU DPP UpgradingEvent semantics.

classes.label: Textile waste
classes.comment: Textile product that the holder discards, intends to discard or is required to discard.

classes.label: Thermo-mechanical recycling process
classes.comment: Recycling process in which thermoplastic textile polymers are remelted or otherwise thermally and mechanically reprocessed into granulate or fibre material.

classes.label: Thread count
classes.comment: Fabric construction characteristic expressing the number of threads per specified unit length in a woven fabric.

classes.label: Threshold comparison operator concept
classes.comment: SKOS concept identifying the comparison operator used by a performance threshold.

classes.label: Toy textile apparel
classes.comment: Textile apparel identified as a toy in accordance with Directive 2009/48/EC.

classes.label: Trim failure
classes.comment: Component failure mode involving failure of trims or auxiliary components associated with a textile product.

classes.label: Twist level
classes.comment: Spinning parameter describing the degree or level of twist inserted into a yarn.

classes.label: Twist number
classes.comment: Spinning parameter describing the number of twists inserted into a yarn.

classes.label: Upgradability
classes.comment: Ability of a product to be accessible for actions that enhance functionality, performance, capacity, safety or aesthetics.

classes.label: Upgrade process
classes.comment: Textile intervention process intended to enhance the functionality, performance, capacity, safety or aesthetics of a product or component.

classes.label: Use and care process
classes.comment: Process occurring during the use or care phase of a textile product, including wearing, washing, drying, cleaning, ironing and storage-related care.

classes.label: User acceptance condition
classes.comment: Contextual condition concerning whether a user accepts the restored function and potentially changed aesthetics of the product after repair.

classes.label: Use-related indicator
classes.comment: Indicator concerning actual or expected product use, use-cycle count or replacement behaviour.

classes.label: Use or wear process
classes.comment: Use-phase process corresponding to wearing, using or exposing a textile product during its intended use.

classes.label: Visual failure mode
classes.comment: Category of failure modes primarily affecting visible appearance.

classes.label: Visual fibre characteristic
classes.comment: Fibre characteristic concerning visual properties such as colour.

classes.label: Visual performance parameter
classes.comment: Category of observed performance parameters related to visual appearance or colour behaviour.

classes.label: Washing process
classes.comment: Care process involving laundering or washing of a textile product.

classes.label: Washing temperature
classes.comment: Care parameter describing the temperature used in a washing process.

classes.label: Weave pattern specification
classes.comment: A process target specification stating the weave pattern to be produced.

classes.label: Weaving process
classes.comment: Fabric manufacturing process in which two sets of yarns are interlaced at right angles on a loom.

classes.label: Wet processing process
classes.comment: Textile manufacturing process involving liquid media, chemical treatment, washing, dyeing, printing or finishing operations.

classes.label: Wrinkling
classes.comment: Durability-related deformation behaviour describing the tendency of a textile material or product to form creases under use or after deformation and recovery cycles.

classes.label: Yarn
classes.comment: Textile product consisting of fibres assembled into a continuous strand and intended to be incorporated into fabric or another textile product.

classes.label: Yarn appearance
classes.comment: Yarn visual characteristic concerning diameter, hairiness, visible defects and overall appearance.

classes.label: Yarn characteristic
classes.comment: Characteristic of a yarn that may influence fabric and product durability.

classes.label: Yarn conditioning
classes.comment: Spinning or post-spinning parameter corresponding to yarn conditioning, such as steaming, that may enhance flexibility, strength or evenness.

classes.label: Yarn elasticity
classes.comment: Yarn mechanical characteristic concerning the ability of yarn to deform and recover.

classes.label: Yarn hairiness
classes.comment: Yarn structural characteristic concerning fibre ends and loops protruding from the yarn body.

classes.label: Yarn manufacturing process
classes.comment: Manufacturing process transforming fibres or filaments into yarns.

classes.label: Yarn mechanical characteristic
classes.comment: Yarn characteristic concerning mechanical behaviour such as yarn strength or elasticity.

classes.label: Yarn softness
classes.comment: Yarn tactile characteristic concerning perceived softness or smoothness.

classes.label: Yarn strength
classes.comment: Yarn mechanical characteristic expressing the ability of a yarn to withstand tensile force without breaking.

classes.label: Yarn structural characteristic
classes.comment: Yarn characteristic concerning structural regularity or configuration.

classes.label: Yarn tactile characteristic
classes.comment: Yarn characteristic concerning tactile or hand-feel behaviour.

classes.label: Yarn uniformity
classes.comment: Yarn structural characteristic expressing uniformity in thickness and mass along the yarn length.

classes.label: Yarn visual characteristic
classes.comment: Yarn characteristic concerning visible appearance or visual quality.

classes.label: Zipper failure
classes.comment: Specific trim failure involving failure of a zipper or zip fastener.

properties.label: addresses failure mode
properties.comment: Relates a concrete repair-related process execution or priority element to a textile failure mode that it addresses.

properties.label: applies method
properties.comment: Relates an assessment execution to the reusable assessment method that it performs.

properties.label: applies sorting criterion
properties.comment: Relates a sorting-for-recycling process to a criterion applied during sorting.

properties.label: applies to
properties.comment: Relates a textile process type or concrete process execution to a textile product to which it applies, including a product used as a component of another product.

properties.label: applies to endpoint
properties.comment: Relates a performance threshold to the test endpoint to which the threshold applies.

properties.label: assesses performance parameter
properties.comment: Relates an assessment execution to the durability-related performance parameter being evaluated.

properties.label: assesses product
properties.comment: Relates an assessment execution to the product being assessed, including a product that is used as a component of another product.

properties.label: assesses recyclability of
properties.comment: Relates a recyclability assessment execution specifically to the product whose recyclability it assesses.

properties.label: assesses recycling route
properties.comment: Relates a recyclability assessment to a recycling route evaluated by that assessment.

properties.label: assesses repairability of
properties.comment: Relates a repairability assessment execution to the textile apparel it assesses.

properties.label: awards score value
properties.comment: Relates a recyclability scoring rule to the dimensionless quantitative score value awarded when the rule is satisfied.

properties.label: barrier applies to route
properties.comment: Relates a recyclability barrier to the recycling route it hinders.

properties.label: calculation assumption
properties.comment: Textual statement of an assumption used in calculating, estimating or interpreting an indicator.

properties.label: calculation description
properties.comment: Textual description of the calculation, aggregation or interpretation procedure used for an indicator.

properties.label: can be disassembled without damage
properties.comment: Indicates whether the assessed product or relevant element was found capable of disassembly without damage in the stated assessment context.

properties.label: characteristic of
properties.comment: Relates a textile structure characteristic occurrence to the textile product that it describes, including a product used as a component of another product.

properties.label: concerns degradation phenomenon
properties.comment: Relates an indicator to an observed textile degradation phenomenon that it interprets.

properties.label: concerns durability aspect
properties.comment: Relates an indicator to the durability concept whose interpretation it supports.

properties.label: concerns failure mode
properties.comment: Relates an indicator to a textile failure mode that it interprets or uses in its derivation.

properties.label: concerns performance parameter
properties.comment: Relates an indicator to the durability-related performance parameter that it interprets.

properties.label: considers process type
properties.comment: Relates a repairability assessment to a repair or other repair-related life-extension process type considered by the assessment.

properties.label: considers repair service
properties.comment: Relates a repairability assessment to a repair service evaluated or considered as evidence.

properties.label: contributes to indicator
properties.comment: Relates an indicator to a broader indicator to which it contributes.

properties.label: covers priority element type
properties.comment: Relates repair guidance to a controlled priority-element type covered by the guidance.

properties.label: criterion for performance parameter
properties.comment: Relates a decision criterion to the durability-related performance parameter to which it applies.

properties.label: defines endpoint
properties.comment: Relates a method or standard to an endpoint or stopping condition it defines.

properties.label: defines method
properties.comment: Relates an assessment standard to an assessment method it defines or specifies.

properties.label: derived from
properties.comment: Relates an indicator to an assessment result or another indicator used as evidence in its calculation, aggregation or interpretation.

properties.label: derived using method
properties.comment: Relates an indicator to the assessment, scoring or interpretive method used to derive it.

properties.label: evaluated against threshold
properties.comment: Relates an indicator to a performance threshold used to interpret or classify its value.

properties.label: evaluates criterion
properties.comment: Relates a criterion result to the controlled criterion it evaluates.

properties.label: executes process type
properties.comment: Relates a concrete textile process execution to the textile process type that it instantiates.

properties.label: follows recycling route
properties.comment: Relates an actual textile recycling event to the route it follows.

properties.label: has barrier type
properties.comment: Classifies a recyclability barrier using a controlled barrier concept.

properties.label: has care instruction
properties.comment: Relates a textile product to product-specific care instructions.

properties.label: has characteristic value
properties.comment: Relates a textile structure characteristic occurrence to a quantitative value containing a number and a measurement unit.

properties.label: has comparison operator
properties.comment: Relates a performance threshold to the controlled comparison operator applied to its threshold value.

properties.label: has component material
properties.comment: Relates a non-textile component to a material occurrence from which the component is made.

properties.label: has condition
properties.comment: Relates an assessment execution to a condition under which it is performed.

properties.label: has constituent indicator
properties.comment: Relates an aggregate or trajectory indicator to a more specific indicator included in its derivation.

properties.label: has context factor type
properties.comment: Identifies the controlled context factor concept observed or declared by a textile context observation.

properties.label: has context observation
properties.comment: Relates a product or a concrete textile process execution to a context observation applying to it.

properties.label: has criterion outcome
properties.comment: Relates a criterion result to its controlled assessment outcome.

properties.label: has criterion result
properties.comment: Relates an aggregate recyclability result to an outcome for one evaluated criterion.

properties.label: has degradation expression
properties.comment: Relates a durability-related performance characteristic to a degradation phenomenon that expresses deterioration of that characteristic. This is an instance-level relation and is not a deterministic causal axiom.

properties.label: has repairability design feature
properties.comment: Relates a repairability assessment to a design feature considered in the assessment.

properties.label: has durability aspect
properties.comment: Relates a textile product to a durability aspect relevant to its assessment or declaration.

properties.label: has priority repair element type
properties.comment: Assigns a controlled element type to a priority repair element role.

properties.label: has end-of-life instruction
properties.comment: Relates a textile product to product-specific instructions for its end-of-life handling.

properties.label: has external damage
properties.comment: Relates a textile product or product observation to external damage occurring during use.

properties.label: has fabric manufacturing method
properties.comment: Relates a fabric manufacturing process type or concrete execution to a controlled fabric-manufacturing-method concept.

properties.label: has failure expression
properties.comment: Relates an observed performance parameter to a failure mode that expresses degradation or loss of that parameter.

properties.label: has failure mode
properties.comment: Relates a textile product to a failure mode observed, expected or considered relevant for that product.

properties.label: has fibre component
properties.comment: Relates a textile product to a textile fibre type concept that is part of its composition.

properties.label: has fibre composition component
properties.comment: Relates a textile product to a structured fibre composition component.

properties.label: has fibre mass fraction
properties.comment: Relates a fibre composition component to the mass fraction of that fibre in the textile product.

properties.label: has fibre type
properties.comment: Relates a fibre composition component to the textile fibre type concept it describes.

properties.label: has indicator
properties.comment: Relates a product to an indicator that describes or interprets it.

properties.label: has interactive repair support
properties.comment: Relates a repair service to interactive real-time repair support.

properties.label: has life-extension intervention aspect
properties.comment: Relates textile apparel to a repairability-related product aspect.

properties.label: has maximum score value
properties.comment: Relates a recyclability scoring method to the maximum dimensionless score value defined by that method.

properties.label: has measured value
properties.comment: Relates a measurement result to its quantitative measured value.

properties.label: has measurement parameter
properties.comment: Relates a method or assessment condition to a protocol parameter it specifies.

properties.label: has measurement unit
properties.comment: Relates a quantitative value to the measurement unit used to express it.

properties.label: has minimum score value
properties.comment: Relates a recyclability scoring method to the minimum dimensionless score value defined by that method.

properties.label: has non-textile component
properties.comment: Relates a textile product to a non-textile component physically integrated into it.

properties.label: has non-textile component type
properties.comment: Relates a non-textile component to a controlled concept describing its component type.

properties.label: has non-textile material mass fraction
properties.comment: Relates a textile product to the mass fraction represented by non-textile materials.

properties.label: has observed degradation phenomenon
properties.comment: Relates a product to a degradation phenomenon observed or considered relevant for that product. A concrete observation, test and result should be represented in the textile assessment module.

properties.label: has observed performance parameter
properties.comment: Relates a textile product to an observed performance parameter relevant to its durability assessment.

properties.label: has packaging material
properties.comment: Relates a textile product to a packaging-material occurrence used for its packaging, transport, storage or delivery.

properties.label: has packaging material type
properties.comment: Relates a packaging material occurrence to a controlled concept describing the material type.

properties.label: has parameter setting
properties.comment: Relates an assessment execution or condition to a concrete parameter setting.

properties.label: has parameter value
properties.comment: Relates a measurement parameter setting to its quantitative value.

properties.label: has presence chemical function
properties.comment: Relates a textile substance occurrence to the chemical function performed in that textile context.

properties.label: has presence use category
properties.comment: Classifies the textile chemical occurrence by whether it is associated with process use, intended performance use or unintended presence. The classification is attached to the occurrence rather than globally to the substance identity.

properties.label: has priority repair element
properties.comment: Relates a repairability assessment to a priority repair element considered in the assessment.

properties.label: has process execution
properties.comment: Relates a textile product, including a product used as a component of another product, to a concrete process execution applied to it or recorded in its lifecycle.

properties.label: has process method
properties.comment: Relates a textile process type or concrete execution to a controlled SKOS concept identifying the selected process method.

properties.label: has process parameter
properties.comment: Relates a textile process type to a process parameter or target specification relevant to that process type. Concrete executions use txtprc:hasProcessParameterSetting.

properties.label: has process parameter setting
properties.comment: Relates a concrete process execution to a concrete parameter setting used in that execution.

properties.label: has quantity kind
properties.comment: Relates a quantitative value to the kind of quantity that it expresses.

properties.label: has rating value
properties.comment: Relates a measurement result to a controlled rating value or grade.

properties.label: has recovered material
properties.comment: Relates an actual textile recycling event to material recovered as an output.

properties.label: has recovered material quality result
properties.comment: Relates an assessment or recycling result to a quality result for the recovered material.

properties.label: has recyclability aspect
properties.comment: Relates a product to its recyclability product aspect.

properties.label: has recyclability assessment
properties.comment: Relates a product to a concrete recyclability assessment performed on it.

properties.label: has recyclability barrier
properties.comment: Relates a route-specific assessment result to a barrier identified during the assessment.

properties.label: has recyclability label
properties.comment: Relates a recyclability score to a controlled method-specific label.

properties.label: has recyclability score
properties.comment: Relates a recyclability assessment result to its method-specific score indicator.

properties.label: has recyclability technology level
properties.comment: Classifies a recyclability assessment result using the shared product-technology-level vocabulary defined in Textile Connector.

properties.label: has recyclable mass fraction value
properties.comment: Relates a recyclability assessment result to the mass fraction judged recyclable for the stated route and conditions.

properties.label: has recycled content aspect
properties.comment: Relates a textile product to the recycled-content product aspect used to organise declarations and assessments.

properties.label: has recycled content assessment
properties.comment: Relates a textile product to a recycled-content assessment execution.

properties.label: has recycled content declaration
properties.comment: Relates a product to a recycled-content declaration.

properties.label: has recycled content mass fraction value
properties.comment: Relates a recycled-content declaration to a quantitative mass fraction expressed using the shared textile value pattern.

properties.label: has recycled content source
properties.comment: Relates a recycled-content declaration to a controlled post-industrial, pre-consumer or post-consumer source category defined by the stated methodology.

properties.label: has recycled content technology level
properties.comment: Classifies a recycled-content assessment result using the shared product-technology-level vocabulary defined in Textile Connector.

properties.label: has recycled material mass value
properties.comment: Relates a recycled-content declaration to the absolute mass of recycled material included in the product.

properties.label: has recycling loop
properties.comment: Relates a route, assessment result or event to the intended material-loop destination.

properties.label: has recycling yield result
properties.comment: Relates an actual textile recycling event to a result reporting the recovered-material yield of that event.

properties.label: has recycling yield value
properties.comment: Relates a recycling yield result to its quantitative value.

properties.label: has reference duration
properties.comment: Relates a reference period to its quantitative duration.

properties.label: has reference product mass value
properties.comment: Relates a recycled-content declaration to the reference product mass, excluding trims where the applicable method requires this basis.

properties.label: has repairability assessment
properties.comment: Relates textile apparel to a repairability assessment execution.

properties.label: has repair action type
properties.comment: Relates a concrete repair process execution to a controlled repair-action method such as patching, mending, button replacement or zipper replacement.

properties.label: has repair actor type
properties.comment: Classifies a DPP actor by its role or category in textile repair.

properties.label: has repair cost condition
properties.comment: Relates a repairability assessment to the repair-cost condition considered.

properties.label: has repair cost-to-new-product price ratio
properties.comment: Relates a repair-cost condition to a dimensionless quantitative ratio between repair cost and the price of a comparable new product.

properties.label: has repair guidance
properties.comment: Relates textile apparel to repair guidance or repair-support information.

properties.label: has repair price transparency
properties.comment: Indicates whether transparent repair-price or cost information is available for the service.

properties.label: has repair response time value
properties.comment: Relates a repair service to a quantitative response-time value expressed with an SI time unit.

properties.label: has repair service
properties.comment: Relates textile apparel to a repair service available for the product or product category.

properties.label: has repair service configuration
properties.comment: Relates a repairability assessment result to a BC, BAT or BNAT service-and-guidance configuration from JRC Table 48.

properties.label: has scale value
properties.comment: Relates a rating scale to one of its controlled rating values.

properties.label: has scoring rule
properties.comment: Relates a recyclability scoring method to a scoring rule used by that method.

properties.label: has spare-part availability condition
properties.comment: Relates a repairability assessment to a spare-part availability condition.

properties.label: has spinning method
properties.comment: Relates a spinning process type or concrete execution to a controlled spinning-method concept.

properties.label: has structural characteristic
properties.comment: Relates a textile product, including a product used as a component of another product, to a textile structure characteristic occurrence.

properties.label: has study scope status
properties.comment: Relates a textile product instance to a controlled study scope status concept.

properties.label: has textile apparel product type
properties.comment: Relates a textile apparel product to a controlled textile apparel product type concept.

properties.label: has textile chemical function
properties.comment: Relates a textile chemical substance to a controlled concept describing its function in textile manufacturing, treatment, finishing or functionalisation.

properties.label: has textile chemical use category
properties.comment: Relates a textile chemical substance to a controlled category describing whether it is used as a process chemical, a performance chemical or occurs unintentionally.

properties.label: has textile fibre mass fraction
properties.comment: Relates a product to the total mass fraction represented by textile fibres.

properties.label: has textile handling information
properties.comment: Relates a textile substance-of-concern presence context to textile-specific safe-use or lifecycle-handling information.

properties.label: has textile location type
properties.comment: Relates a location information object to a controlled textile-specific location type.

properties.label: has textile product-group reference
properties.comment: Relates a textile type (d) qualification to the versioned textile product-group reference supporting that qualification.

properties.label: has threshold rating value
properties.comment: Relates a performance threshold to a controlled rating value used as its comparison level.

properties.label: has threshold value
properties.comment: Relates a performance threshold to its quantitative comparison value.

properties.label: has user acceptance condition
properties.comment: Relates a repairability assessment to a user-acceptance condition.

properties.label: has user acceptance status
properties.comment: Relates a user-acceptance condition to a controlled acceptance status recorded in the assessment context.
