enumerations.comment: SKOS concept used as a controlled value for textile fibre type in a fibre composition.

values.label: Acetate
values.comment: A man-made cellulosic fibre listed in the JRC classification of commonly used textile fibres.

values.label: Acrylic
values.comment: A synthetic polymer fibre listed in the JRC classification of commonly used textile fibres.

values.label: Animal origin fibre
values.comment: A natural-origin textile fibre category that includes wool, silk and hair.

values.label: Chemical fibre
values.comment: A man-made textile fibre category that includes man-made cellulosic fibres and synthetic polymer fibres.

values.label: Cotton
values.comment: A vegetable-origin textile fibre listed in the JRC classification of commonly used textile fibres.

values.label: Cupro
values.comment: A man-made cellulosic fibre listed in the JRC classification of commonly used textile fibres.

values.label: Elastane
values.comment: A synthetic polymer fibre listed in the JRC classification of commonly used textile fibres.

values.label: Flax
values.comment: A vegetable-origin textile fibre listed in the JRC classification of commonly used textile fibres.

values.label: Hair
values.comment: An animal-origin textile fibre listed in the JRC classification of commonly used textile fibres.

values.label: Jute
values.comment: A vegetable-origin textile fibre listed in the JRC classification of commonly used textile fibres.

values.label: Lyocell
values.comment: A man-made cellulosic fibre listed in the JRC classification of commonly used textile fibres.

values.label: Man-made cellulosic fibre
values.comment: A man-made cellulosic fibre category that includes viscose, cupro, lyocell, acetate and triacetate.

values.label: Natural origin fibre
values.comment: A textile fibre category of natural origin.

values.label: Polyamide
values.comment: A synthetic polymer fibre listed in the JRC classification of commonly used textile fibres.

values.label: Polyester
values.comment: A synthetic polymer fibre listed in the JRC classification of commonly used textile fibres.

values.label: Polypropylene
values.comment: A synthetic polymer fibre listed in the JRC classification of commonly used textile fibres.

values.label: Silk
values.comment: An animal-origin textile fibre listed in the JRC classification of commonly used textile fibres.

values.label: Synthetic polymer fibre
values.comment: A synthetic polymer fibre category that includes polyester, polyamide, acrylic, polypropylene and elastane.

values.label: Triacetate
values.comment: A man-made cellulosic fibre listed in the JRC classification of commonly used textile fibres.

values.label: Vegetable origin fibre
values.comment: A natural-origin textile fibre category that includes cotton, flax and jute.

values.label: Viscose
values.comment: A man-made cellulosic fibre listed in the JRC classification of commonly used textile fibres.

values.label: Wool
values.comment: An animal-origin textile fibre listed in the JRC classification of commonly used textile fibres.

enumerations.label: Non-textile component type concept
enumerations.comment: A controlled SKOS concept used to classify the functional type of a non-textile component.

values.label: Buckle
values.comment: A buckle integrated into a textile product.

values.label: Button
values.comment: A button integrated into a textile product.

values.label: Decorative hardware
values.comment: Decorative non-textile hardware integrated into a textile product.

values.label: Hook-and-loop fastener
values.comment: A hook-and-loop fastening component integrated into a textile product.

values.label: Metal rivet
values.comment: A metal rivet integrated into a textile product.

values.label: Printed label or tag
values.comment: A printed label or tag integrated into or attached to a textile product.

values.label: Sequin
values.comment: A sequin integrated into a textile product.

values.label: Snap fastener
values.comment: A snap fastener integrated into a textile product.

values.label: Zipper
values.comment: A zipper integrated into a textile product.

enumerations.label: Packaging material type concept
enumerations.comment: A controlled SKOS concept used to classify a packaging material occurrence.

values.label: Cardboard packaging material
values.comment: Packaging material made primarily of cardboard.

values.label: Paper packaging material
values.comment: Packaging material made primarily of paper.

values.label: Plastic packaging material
values.comment: Packaging material made primarily of plastic.

values.label: Polyethylene packaging material
values.comment: Plastic packaging material made from polyethylene.

values.label: Polyethylene terephthalate packaging material
values.comment: Plastic packaging material made from polyethylene terephthalate.

values.label: Polypropylene packaging material
values.comment: Plastic packaging material made from polypropylene.

values.label: Polyvinyl chloride packaging material
values.comment: Plastic packaging material made from polyvinyl chloride. The vocabulary term does not imply that this material satisfies an applicable packaging requirement.

enumerations.label: Pre-treatment technique concept
enumerations.comment: SKOS concept used to classify a technique that prepares textile waste for a recycling process.

values.label: Disassembly pre-treatment
values.comment: Pre-treatment in which product parts or stitches are loosened, dissolved or otherwise separated before recycling.

values.label: Manual separation pre-treatment
values.comment: Manual removal of non-textile parts from fibre-containing textile parts.

values.label: Mechanical separation pre-treatment
values.comment: Mechanical separation of non-textile parts, potentially combined with shredding.

values.label: Shredding pre-treatment
values.comment: Pre-treatment in which textile material is shredded to improve the efficiency of a subsequent recycling technique.

enumerations.label: Priority repair element type concept
enumerations.comment: SKOS concept identifying a priority repair element type such as fabric, zipper, button or embellishment.

values.label: Button repair element
values.comment: Priority repair element type corresponding to a button.

values.label: Embellishment repair element
values.comment: Priority repair element type corresponding to embellishments such as sequins, gems or beads.

values.label: Fabric repair element
values.comment: Priority repair element type corresponding to fabric or a fabric area.

values.label: Zipper repair element
values.comment: Priority repair element type corresponding to a zipper or zip fastener.

enumerations.label: Product technology level concept
enumerations.comment: Controlled concept classifying a product technology as base case, best available technology or best not-yet-available technology.

values.label: Base case technology level
values.comment: Product technology representing the average product or base case considered in an assessment.

values.label: Best available technology level
values.comment: Product technology with ambitious performance that is available on the market and implemented at scale.

values.label: Best not-yet-available technology level
values.comment: Product technology with ambitious performance that is not yet implemented at scale and is therefore not considered available on the market.

enumerations.label: Recyclability barrier type concept
enumerations.comment: Controlled concept classifying a recyclability barrier.

values.label: Chemical-finish barrier
values.comment: Barrier caused by a chemical finish that hinders a recycling route or degrades recovered-material quality.

values.label: Coating barrier
values.comment: A coating interferes with separation, recycling or recovered-material quality.

values.label: Collection or sorting system barrier
values.comment: The assumed collection or sorting system cannot reliably direct the product to the intended recycling route.

values.label: Dark-colour sorting barrier
values.comment: Dark colour limits the performance of an assumed automated textile identification or sorting technique.

values.label: Different inner and outer fibre sorting barrier
values.comment: Different fibre compositions in inner and outer layers limit reliable automated identification or separation.

values.label: Dye barrier
values.comment: A dye or colour system interferes with a selected recycling route or recovered-material quality.

values.label: High elastane content barrier
values.comment: Elastane content exceeds a route-specific acceptable value.

values.label: High-risk coating barrier
values.comment: Barrier associated with polyurethane, polyacrylate, PVC, fluorocarbon or rubber coatings identified as high risk for recycling.

values.label: High-risk chemical-finish barrier
values.comment: Barrier associated with chemical finishes identified as high risk for recycling, including selected flame-retardant, anti-pilling, wrinkle-resistant, colour-fastness or repellent treatments.

values.label: Insufficient composition information barrier
values.comment: Composition or dismantling data are insufficient for reliable route selection.

values.label: Medium-risk coating barrier
values.comment: Barrier associated with a coating such as silicone that is identified as a medium recycling risk.

values.label: Minor fibre detection barrier
values.comment: A minor fibre content may fall below the reliable detection capability of the assumed automated sorting technique.

values.label: Mixed-fibre composition barrier
values.comment: Mixed fibre composition hinders or constrains the selected recycling route.

values.label: Multi-layer construction sorting barrier
values.comment: A multi-layer construction limits reliable automated identification or separation for recycling.

values.label: Non-textile component barrier
values.comment: A non-textile component interferes with sorting, preparation or recycling.

values.label: Printing barrier
values.comment: A printed layer or ink system interferes with a selected recycling route.

values.label: Reactive or sulphur dye barrier
values.comment: Barrier associated with reactive dyes, sulphur dyes or pigments that may hinder recycling or affect recovered-material quality.

values.label: Sequin barrier
values.comment: Sequins or similar decorative components interfere with processing or stream purity.

values.label: Substance-of-concern barrier
values.comment: A substance presence or qualification hinders reuse, recycling or recovered-material use.

values.label: Unavailable data carrier barrier
values.comment: The product data carrier is missing, damaged or inaccessible at end of life, preventing retrieval of reliable sorting and recycling information.

enumerations.label: Recyclability criterion concept
enumerations.comment: Controlled concept identifying a criterion used in a recyclability assessment.

values.label: Coating absence criterion
values.comment: Method-specific criterion evaluating absence of coatings that may interfere with a selected recycling route.

values.label: Absence of disruptive elements criterion
values.comment: Whether the product lacks elements or substances that disrupt collection, sorting, preparation or recycling or limit recovered-fibre use.

values.label: Dye absence criterion
values.comment: Method-specific criterion evaluating whether dyes interfere with the intended recycling route. It must not be interpreted as a universal requirement that recyclable textiles be undyed.

values.label: Effective collection criterion
values.comment: Whether the product can be effectively collected for subsequent recycling.

values.label: Elastane proportion criterion
values.comment: Method-specific criterion evaluating whether the elastane mass fraction is compatible with the selected recycling route.

values.label: Fibre composition eligibility criterion
values.comment: Whether the fibre composition meets route-specific thresholds used by the assessment method.

values.label: Fibre feedstock use criterion
values.comment: Whether the fibre content can be used as feedstock for one or more recycling techniques producing fibres usable in textile products.

values.label: Information criterion
values.comment: Criterion concerning availability and accessibility of data needed for recycling decisions.

values.label: Inner and outer composition similarity criterion
values.comment: Method-specific criterion comparing the composition of inner and outer product structures.

values.label: Material choice criterion
values.comment: Whether selected materials and combinations are compatible with the intended recycling route.

values.label: Material separability criterion
values.comment: Whether different materials or components can be separated with effort and damage compatible with the intended recycling route.

values.label: Mechanical recycling compatibility criterion
values.comment: Whether the product or material stream is compatible with the stated mechanical recycling process.

values.label: Mono-material criterion
values.comment: Method-specific criterion evaluating whether the product or assessed material group consists of one principal material stream.

values.label: Preparation for recycling criterion
values.comment: Whether the product can be prepared for recycling, or sent directly to recycling without route-incompatible preparation.

values.label: Printing absence criterion
values.comment: Method-specific criterion evaluating absence of printing that may interfere with a selected recycling route.

values.label: Product-design criterion
values.comment: Criterion concerning product composition, components, finishes or construction.

values.label: Recycling information availability criterion
values.comment: Whether composition, dismantling and other route-relevant product data are accessible to recycling actors.

values.label: Route-specific criterion
values.comment: Criterion whose outcome depends on the selected recycling technology or route.

values.label: Sequin absence criterion
values.comment: Method-specific criterion evaluating absence of sequins or similar attached decorative components.

values.label: Sortability criterion
values.comment: Whether the product can be segregated from other waste and assigned to an appropriate recycling stream.

values.label: Substance restriction criterion
values.comment: Whether substances that hinder the intended recycling route are absent or below the applicable route-specific threshold.

values.label: System-condition criterion
values.comment: Criterion concerning collection, sorting or preparation conditions outside the product itself.

enumerations.label: Recyclability label concept
enumerations.comment: Controlled categorical label used by a specified recyclability scoring method.

values.label: Conditional recyclability label
values.comment: Method-specific label indicating recyclability only for certain routes, conditions or pre-treatments.

values.label: High recyclability label
values.comment: Method-specific label indicating a comparatively favourable assessment outcome under stated assumptions.

values.label: Limited recyclability label
values.comment: Method-specific label indicating substantial barriers or restricted route compatibility.

enumerations.label: Recyclability outcome concept
enumerations.comment: Controlled concept expressing the outcome of a recyclability criterion.

values.label: Criterion not applicable
values.comment: The criterion does not apply to the assessed route or product context.

values.label: Criterion not assessed
values.comment: The criterion was not evaluated.

values.label: Criterion not satisfied
values.comment: The assessed evidence does not satisfy the criterion.

values.label: Criterion partly satisfied
values.comment: The assessed evidence partly satisfies the criterion.

values.label: Criterion satisfied
values.comment: The assessed evidence satisfies the criterion.

values.label: Criterion outcome uncertain
values.comment: The available evidence is insufficient for a confident outcome.

enumerations.label: Recycled content source concept
enumerations.comment: Controlled concept identifying the lifecycle source category of recycled content, including post-industrial, pre-consumer and post-consumer material. The declaration or method must state the definition framework used because ISO and ESPR terminology are not fully aligned.

values.label: Post-consumer recycled content
values.comment: Recycled material recovered from products after use by consumers or end users.

values.label: Post-industrial recycled content
values.comment: Recycled material originating from industrial production waste, using the ESPR-oriented source terminology described by the DPP content study.

values.label: Pre-consumer recycled content
values.comment: Recycled material recovered from waste generated before a product reaches the consumer.

enumerations.label: Recycling loop concept
enumerations.comment: Controlled concept identifying the intended material-loop destination of a recycling route.

values.label: Fibre-to-fibre recycling
values.comment: Recycling route intended to produce fibre or material feedstock usable in textile products.

values.label: Open-loop recycling
values.comment: Recycling route producing material for a product system other than textile fibre-to-fibre use.

enumerations.label: Repair action type concept
enumerations.comment: Controlled process-method concept identifying a textile repair action such as patching, mending, button replacement or zipper replacement.

values.label: Button replacement
values.comment: Repair action replacing a missing or damaged button.

values.label: Mending
values.comment: Repair action involving mending of textile apparel or a fabric area.

values.label: Patching
values.comment: Repair action using a patch to restore a damaged fabric area.

values.label: Zipper replacement
values.comment: Repair action replacing a damaged zipper or zip fastener.

enumerations.label: Repair actor type concept
enumerations.comment: SKOS concept used to classify the role or category of an actor participating in textile repair.

values.label: Company or brand repair actor
values.comment: Company or brand providing or organising repair services for textile apparel.

values.label: Consumer self-repair actor
values.comment: Consumer or user performing self-repair.

values.label: Independent professional repairer
values.comment: Independent professional actor providing paid textile repair services.

values.label: Repair café or community repair actor
values.comment: Community organisation, association or repair café supporting unpaid or assisted repair.

enumerations.label: Repair service configuration concept
enumerations.comment: SKOS concept representing a BC, BAT or BNAT repair-service and guidance configuration from JRC Table 48.

values.label: Best available repair service configuration
values.comment: Professional repair services are available and transparent; detailed repair guidance covers common damaged elements; company repair service is available throughout the sales region.

values.label: Base-case repair service configuration
values.comment: Professional repair services are available but have long response times, reduced transparency and consumer mistrust; repair support is very limited and company service is available only in parts of the sales region.

values.label: Best not-yet-available repair service configuration
values.comment: Interactive real-time repair support is available through augmented reality, artificial intelligence or another technology, and company repair service is available throughout the sales region.

enumerations.label: Sorting criterion concept
enumerations.comment: SKOS concept used to classify a criterion applied during sorting for recycling.

values.label: Colour sorting criterion
values.comment: Sorting criterion based on colour, especially relevant where colour transfers to the recovered output.

values.label: Fibre-composition sorting criterion
values.comment: Sorting criterion based on the fibre composition of textile waste.

values.label: Product-construction sorting criterion
values.comment: Sorting criterion based on product or fabric construction, including mono-layer or multi-layer and woven or knitted structures.

values.label: Product-type sorting criterion
values.comment: Sorting criterion based on the type of textile product.

enumerations.label: Sorting technique concept
enumerations.comment: SKOS concept used to classify a textile sorting technique.

values.label: Automated sorting technique
values.comment: Machine-based sorting technique, including systems using near-infrared spectroscopy or product identifiers.

values.label: Hybrid sorting technique
values.comment: Sorting technique combining human inspection and automated sorting.

values.label: Manual sorting technique
values.comment: Sorting technique based on human inspection.

enumerations.label: Spinning method concept
enumerations.comment: SKOS concept used as a controlled value for a spinning method.

values.label: Air-jet spinning
values.comment: Spinning method associated in the JRC discussion with highly uniform and smooth yarns, but less durable yarns for yarn strength.

values.label: Ring spinning
values.comment: Spinning method associated with fine and strong yarns due to good fibre control, orientation and alignment.

values.label: Rotor open-end spinning
values.comment: Spinning method associated with bulkier yarns and reduced strength compared with ring spinning in the JRC discussion.

enumerations.label: Study scope status concept
enumerations.comment: SKOS concept used to indicate whether a textile product type is included in, excluded from, or otherwise qualified with respect to a study or regulatory modelling scope.

values.label: Excluded from JRC preparatory study scope
values.comment: Study scope status indicating that the textile product type is excluded from the JRC preparatory study scope without implying that it is not a textile product.

values.label: Included in JRC preparatory study scope
values.comment: Study scope status indicating that the textile product type is included in the JRC preparatory study scope.

enumerations.label: Textile apparel product type concept
enumerations.comment: SKOS concept used as a controlled value for classifying textile apparel product types.

values.label: Belt
values.comment: Flexible band or strap worn around the waist or over the shoulders, used to secure or hold up clothing such as pants.

values.label: Dresses, skirts and jumpsuits
values.comment: One-piece garment covering the upper and lower body, or the lower body only, other than pants and shorts.

values.label: Glove or mitten
values.comment: Article of clothing used in pairs to protect hands and wrists from the elements or as a fashion item.

values.label: Hat
values.comment: Textile apparel accessory used to cover the head for warmth or as a fashion item, including caps, flat caps, woollen hats, beanies, fedoras, panamas, bowlers, newsboys and berets.

values.label: Jackets and coats
values.comment: Garments worn on top of a shirt or sweater or intended to protect from natural elements, including blazers, suit jackets, overcoats, rain jackets, parkas and anoraks.

values.label: Leggings, stockings, tights and socks
values.comment: Tight garment to cover the legs and/or feet.

values.label: Non-PPE workwear
values.comment: Workwear included in the JRC preparatory study scope when it is not classified as personal protective equipment.

values.label: Pants and shorts
values.comment: Garment to cover the lower body, including casual pants, jeans, sports pants, dress pants and shorts.

values.label: Scarf or tie
values.comment: Textile apparel accessory worn around the neck for warmth or as a fashion item, including warm and light scarves, buffs, neckerchiefs, headscarves, shawls, bowties and ties.

values.label: Shirts and blouses
values.comment: Garment to cover the upper body including the entire arm, including long-sleeved shirts, blouses and base layers.

values.label: Sweaters, pullovers and mid-layers
values.comment: Garment to keep the upper body warm and covered, including pullovers, cardigans, hoodies, jerseys, sweatshirts and sweaters.

values.label: Swimwear
values.comment: Garment worn for water-based or sun-based activities, including bikinis, bathing suits, racing-style swimwear and board shorts.

values.label: Textile apparel accessory
values.comment: Controlled product-type concept corresponding to the textile apparel accessories category in JRC Table 7, including hats, scarves and ties, belts, gloves and mittens.

values.label: T-shirts and tops
values.comment: Garment to cover the upper body to the elbow, including singlets, vests, T-shirts, polo shirts and other short-sleeved shirts.

values.label: Underwear
values.comment: Garment worn under clothes, often next to the skin of the upper or lower body, including boxers, briefs, panties, bras and body-shaping suits.

values.label: Workwear
values.comment: Textile apparel designed or used for professional or occupational contexts.

enumerations.label: Textile chemical function concept
enumerations.comment: A controlled concept describing the technical function performed by a chemical in textile production or treatment.

values.label: Acid dye
values.comment: Dye function corresponding to acid dyes used for compatible fibre types such as wool, silk or polyamide.

values.label: Acid or alkali
values.comment: Chemical function involving pH adjustment or chemical treatment during textile preparation, dyeing or finishing.

values.label: Antimicrobial agent
values.comment: Chemical function intended to prevent or limit growth of microorganisms on textile materials or products.

values.label: Basic dye
values.comment: Dye function corresponding to basic or cationic dyes used for compatible fibre types such as acrylic fibres.

values.label: Biocide
values.comment: Chemical function involving biocidal activity. Depending on use, a biocide may be a process chemical, such as a preservative, or a performance chemical intended to remain in the article.

values.label: Bleaching agent
values.comment: Chemical function involving bleaching or decolourising textile materials during preparation or finishing.

values.label: Disperse dye
values.comment: Dye function corresponding to disperse dyes used for compatible synthetic fibres.

values.label: Dispersing agent
values.comment: Chemical function involving dispersion of dyes, pigments or other substances in a textile-processing formulation.

values.label: Dye
values.comment: Chemical function involving imparting colour to textile fibres, yarns, fabrics or finished textile products.

values.label: Finishing agent
values.comment: Chemical function involving modification of appearance, handle or functional behaviour during textile finishing.

values.label: Fixing agent
values.comment: Chemical function involving improved fixation of a dye or finishing substance on a textile material.

values.label: Flame retardant
values.comment: Chemical function intended to reduce flammability or delay ignition and flame propagation in a textile material.

values.label: Levelling agent
values.comment: Chemical function involving promotion of uniform dye uptake or colour distribution during dyeing.

values.label: Pigment
values.comment: Chemical function involving imparting colour through a pigment used in textile printing, coating or related treatment.

values.label: Sizing agent
values.comment: Chemical function involving application of sizing to improve yarn strength, smoothness or processability.

values.label: Softener
values.comment: Chemical function involving improvement of textile handle or drape. A softener may be used as an auxiliary or may remain as a finishing chemical, depending on the process.

values.label: Solvent
values.comment: Chemical function involving dissolution or carrying of other substances in textile processing.

values.label: Stain repellent
values.comment: Chemical function intended to reduce retention or penetration of stains in a textile material.

values.label: Surfactant
values.comment: Chemical function involving reduction of surface tension in a textile-processing operation.

values.label: UV absorber or stabiliser
values.comment: Chemical function covering ultraviolet absorbers or stabilisers added to reduce radiation-induced degradation of textile materials.

values.label: UV protectant
values.comment: Chemical function intended to protect a textile material from ultraviolet radiation or related degradation.

values.label: Water repellent
values.comment: Chemical function intended to confer water repellency to a textile material.

values.label: Wetting agent
values.comment: Surfactant function intended to improve wetting or liquid penetration of textile fibres, yarns or fabrics during wet processing.

enumerations.label: Textile chemical use category concept
enumerations.comment: A controlled concept describing whether a chemical is intended to act during processing, remain for product performance, or occur unintentionally.

values.label: Performance chemical
values.comment: A chemical intended to remain in the final textile article at a concentration needed to provide a desired function.

values.label: Process chemical
values.comment: A chemical used during textile processing and not intended to remain in the final textile product.

values.label: Unintended chemical substance
values.comment: A contaminant or degradation product not intended to remain in the finished textile and having no intended function in textile processing or in the final product.

enumerations.label: Textile context factor concept
enumerations.comment: A SKOS concept identifying the type of contextual condition observed or declared for a textile product or process execution.

values.label: Abrasion exposure
values.comment: Exposure of a textile product to rubbing, friction or abrasion during use.

values.label: Active or inactive storage
values.comment: Whether a textile item is stored for regular access and use or kept unused for an extended period.

values.label: Bleaching practice
values.comment: Practice or condition describing whether bleaching is used and under what care conditions.

values.label: Care behaviour
values.comment: User choices and practices affecting laundering, drying, ironing, storage or maintenance of a textile product.

values.label: Care context factor
values.comment: Context factor related to laundering, cleaning, drying, ironing, bleaching or other care practices.

values.label: Care-instruction compliance
values.comment: Extent to which the user follows the care instructions provided for a textile product.

values.label: Cleaning frequency
values.comment: How often a textile product undergoes laundering, professional cleaning, hand washing, airing, steaming or another cleaning operation.

values.label: Detergent use practice
values.comment: Practice concerning the choice and dosing of detergent or softener during textile care.

values.label: Drying practice
values.comment: Method or practice used to dry a textile product, such as tumble drying, indoor line drying or outdoor line drying.

values.label: Duration of use
values.comment: The duration for which a product is used during a stated episode or reference period, distinct from an estimated product lifetime.

values.label: Environmental exposure context factor
values.comment: Context factor related to sunlight, ultraviolet radiation, humidity, moisture, temperature or external chemicals.

values.label: External chemical exposure
values.comment: Exposure of a textile product to an external chemical formulation during care or use; the substance or formulation should be identified separately where possible.

values.label: Folding or hanging condition
values.comment: Whether and how a textile product is folded or hung during storage.

values.label: Frequency of use
values.comment: How often a textile product is used or worn during a stated reference period.

values.label: Humidity exposure
values.comment: Exposure of a textile product to a stated ambient humidity condition.

values.label: Intensity of use
values.comment: The severity or demanding nature of product use; any implementation must define the scale or operational criterion used.

values.label: Ironing practice
values.comment: Practice and frequency with which a textile product is ironed or steamed.

values.label: Laundry sorting practice
values.comment: Practice used to sort textile items before washing, for example by colour, fibre type or washing temperature.

values.label: Mechanical stress
values.comment: Mechanical loading or deformation imposed on a textile product during use.

values.label: Moisture exposure
values.comment: Exposure of a textile product to moisture or a wet condition, distinguished from ambient relative humidity.

values.label: Repair behaviour
values.comment: User behaviour concerning self-repair, seeking help or using a professional repair service.

values.label: Replacement behaviour
values.comment: User behaviour concerning substitution or disposal of a textile product; replacement frequency remains a derived indicator in TEXTILE_INDICATOR.

values.label: Storage context factor
values.comment: Context factor related to storage practice or storage conditions.

values.label: Storage humidity
values.comment: Ambient humidity condition applying while a textile product is stored.

values.label: Storage sunlight exposure
values.comment: Exposure to sunlight while a textile product is stored.

values.label: Sunlight exposure
values.comment: Exposure of a textile product to direct or indirect sunlight during drying, storage or use.

values.label: Temperature exposure
values.comment: Exposure of a textile product to a stated temperature condition during use, care, drying, ironing or storage.

values.label: Use context factor
values.comment: Context factor related to how a textile product is used or worn.

values.label: User behaviour factor
values.comment: Context factor related to user choices affecting care, repair, storage, replacement or product use.

values.label: Ultraviolet exposure
values.comment: Exposure of a textile product to ultraviolet radiation; the source and exposure conditions should be stated where known.

values.label: Washing frequency
values.comment: How often a textile product is washed during a stated reference period.

enumerations.label: Textile SoC location type concept
enumerations.comment: Controlled concept describing a textile-specific kind of product location used to qualify a substance location statement.

values.label: Adhesive or bonding layer location
values.comment: The substance is located in an adhesive, laminate, bonding film or other joining layer.

values.label: Coating or finish location
values.comment: The substance is located in a coating, finish or functional surface treatment applied to the textile product.

values.label: Fibre composition location
values.comment: The substance is located in a fibre-composition material group, including a fibre-, yarn- or fabric-based part.

values.label: Non-textile component location
values.comment: The substance is located in a non-textile component such as a button, zipper, buckle, rivet, sequin or other hard component.

values.label: Printed or dyed region location
values.comment: The substance is located in a printed, dyed or otherwise colour-treated region of the textile product.

values.label: Unknown textile product location
values.comment: The product contains the substance but the more specific location within the textile product has not been determined or disclosed.

values.label: Whole textile product location
values.comment: The substance is reported as distributed throughout, or only locatable at the level of, the whole textile product.

enumerations.label: Textile waste source concept
enumerations.comment: Controlled concept classifying textile waste according to the lifecycle stage at which it became waste.

values.label: Fabric or confectioning-stage textile waste
values.comment: Post-industrial textile waste generated during fabric manufacturing or apparel confectioning.

values.label: Fibre-stage textile waste
values.comment: Post-industrial textile waste generated during fibre manufacturing or preparation.

values.label: Post-consumer textile waste
values.comment: Textile product discarded after consumption and use by citizens or by end users in commercial or industrial activities.

values.label: Post-industrial textile waste
values.comment: Textile waste generated during manufacturing of textile products or their fibre, yarn and fabric precursors, including cutting waste, roll ends, excess material, production errors and certain discarded finished products.

values.label: Pre-consumer textile waste
values.comment: Textile waste generated at the retailer stage by discarding unsold products because of overstock, obsolescence, damage, defects or qualifying returns.

values.label: Spinning-stage textile waste
values.comment: Post-industrial textile waste generated during yarn spinning.

enumerations.label: User acceptance status concept
enumerations.comment: Controlled rating-value concept describing the recorded acceptance status of a repaired product in a stated assessment context.

values.label: Accepted by user
values.comment: The repaired product is accepted by the user in the stated assessment context.

values.label: Not accepted by user
values.comment: The repaired product is not accepted by the user in the stated assessment context.

values.label: User acceptance unknown
values.comment: User acceptance has not been observed, declared or assessed.
